_doc: Claims the system makes ABOUT ITSELF, each with a mechanical check. Seeded 2026-10-21 (GAUNTLET, Council 4-1) after three such claims were found false in one night. 'expected' records the verdict known at seeding, so a CHANGE is visible, not just a failure. Run: python3 scripts/check_claims.py

claims.claim: roster-provenance.csv is kept current by the weekly in-season pull
claims.note: No writer exists in either repo. Fixing this is D-INT-1, still an owner decision.

claims.claim: the provenance freshness gate runs during the morning run
claims.note: season_board.py imports rank_engine's functions, never its main(), so the gate is dormant in-season.

claims.claim: the deck's live ESPN roster verification is the in-season control for team labels
claims.note: The kit imports only verify_rosters.norm (the name fold), not the verification. This is why D-INT-1 option (c) was withdrawn on 2026-10-21.

claims.claim: the Season Deck is rebuilt by the morning run
claims.asserted_in: scripts/morning.py step list; the morning scheduled task
claims.note: Known-answer control: the detector must be able to return SUPPORTED (adversarial-verify rule 9).

Known-answer control for writer_exists. gates.py writes it via open(a.out, 'w') where --out's default carries the path; the detector failed this case on first run (2026-10-21) and was generalized to follow argparse defaults. Regression guard.
